Klasse MovementHandler

java.lang.Object
org.golfit.server.handlers.MovementHandler
public class MovementHandler extends Object
Handles movement input messages from clients on the server side. Parses force vectors and applies them to the physics simulation.

    • onMoveInput

      public void onMoveInput(ClientHandler clientHandler, MessageParser.Message message)
      Handles a movement input from a client. Parses the "forceX,forceY" payload and applies the stroke to the player's ball in the simulation.
      Parameter:
      clientHandler - the client that sent the input
      message - the parsed message containing the force payload
